The plate is square, about 26 cm across in the image (roughly 450 px), so about 17 px per cm. The food covers about 330 px by 150 px at its widest, which is roughly 19 cm by 8 cm. It is a small, low pile.

The food looks like a roasted chicken piece (a thigh or part of a breast) on the left, plus shredded or stewed meat, possibly with rice or grains, on the right. I estimate the chicken piece at about 80 g and the shredded portion at about 100 g, for a total of about 180 g.

At roughly 1.6 kcal/g for this kind of mixed dish, 180 g comes to about 290 kcal. Allowing for some oil, I'll estimate about 300 kcal.
